tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows hypoxemia, anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, elevated ferritin, and a prolonged INR. These findings suggest bone marrow suppression or infiltration, possible infection or inflammation, and impaired oxygenation. The elevated ferritin and CRP support an inflammatory process. Immediate clinical evaluation is recommended to rule out serious underlying conditions such as sepsis, hematologic disorders, or acute respiratory pathology.
